sentences.en: My apathy for voting comes from my distaste for politics.
sentences.zh: 我对投票漠不关心是因为我讨厌政治。

sentences.en: We are entitled to vote at the age of twenty.
sentences.zh: 我们在二十岁时就有权投票。

sentences.en: Management will have all employees vote at the upcoming meeting.
sentences.zh: 管理层将在即将举行的会议上让所有员工进行投票。

senses.zh: 提议，使投票；投票决定；公认
